description: Active Atlantic tropical cyclones from the NOAA National Hurricane Center, AND the areas it is watching for development that do not have names yet, with their formation chances. Covers hurricane season (June–November) for Crosby, TX. Returns an explicit all-clear only when there are neither — a quiet CurrentStorms list does not by itself mean a quiet basin.
name: get_tropical_outlook

area.description: NHC's own name for the area, in official English.

chance48Category.description: low / medium / high, NHC's own wording.

disturbances.description: Areas the NHC is watching for development but has NOT named — the shaded areas on its graphical outlook. `null` means the outlook could not be read (status unknown); `[]` means the NHC is watching nothing — two different states. A formation chance is neither a storm nor a forecast track.

outlookIssued.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last data refresh.

storms.description: Named/numbered cyclones only. Empty is common and does not by itself mean nothing is brewing; unnamed areas are in `disturbances`.

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last data refresh.

title: Atlantic tropical outlook
